verdict.rationale: Floot exposes a remote MCP server. Through it, an AI client can build and ship full-stack apps and manage them with tools such as get_logs, query_database/execute_sql, pull_database_schema, create_checkpoint and generate_image. That is real programmatic control, but it is mediated by an AI assistant over MCP rather than a conventional platform API, and probes found no OpenAPI/REST spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP platform API with an OpenAPI spec, explicit programmatic endpoints for creating, listing and deleting projects or publishing, authentication/API-key docs for direct calls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
